qualified_existing.prepared_expiry: Installed UID1017 proof: eligible at hook entry, expiry before hook return, no expired prompt/derived context in either provider request, including reload; scope before core request admission.
qualified_existing.clock_projection: StableTimeClock fresh same-UID private host-counter read projects helper sample forward, validates counter monotonicity/frequency, bounds reader age <=2s and remaining lease. Does not continuously update projected bounds after return.
qualified_existing.recovery: HTTP opaque retry max_attempts=1 and explicit HTTP/auth/WS request rechecks preserve original record/turn/deadline/epoch.

source_counterexample.http: core/client.rs2118-2125 admits, then endpoint/responses.rs84 prepares encoded request; endpoint/session.rs145-153 subsequently awaits AuthProvider.apply_auth before transport.stream. Async auth may delay after the authoritative check; no expiry check below it.
source_counterexample.websocket: core/client.rs2473-2487 admits before ResponsesWebsocketConnection.stream_request; endpoint/responses_websocket.rs327 serializes,330 spawns,362-370 awaits stream mutex,178 queues WsCommand,122 sends from a separate pump. No admission handle is passed through options/command to recheck after these waits.
source_counterexample.observation: A qualifying sample at t0 plus delayed mutex/pump/auth completion at t1>=expiry can still initiate provider send using t0 permission. This is source evidence, not an executed red/green regression or observed installed violation.

minimal_remediation.action: Carry optional bounded admission callback across API boundary; recheck after HTTP auth/request preparation and after WS stream-lock/command-queue waiting inside actual sender, before sending the first provider message. Preserve existing outer checks and explicit retries. Rejected admission must emit a distinct pre-send outcome without leaking staged input/history or clearing independent socket state.
minimal_remediation.test_seam: Reuse queue_service bounded-input integration and core_test_support WebSocketTestServer wait_for_request. Freeze qualified clock, block public AuthProvider.apply_auth or an actual occupied WS stream, cross deadline while blocked, release and assert zero newly expired bounded provider requests; allow an unexpired control and check reload history. Direct API-only/private-mutex tests cannot alone establish full bounded queue contract.

residual_semantics: Moving the check into sender removes known asynchronous gaps; it cannot guarantee strict remote model execution deadline through arbitrary OS suspension between final trusted counter read and network syscall, or network/provider delay. Literal remote-start guarantee requires provider-side enforcement of the original expiry. Otherwise operator must explicitly accept an application-admission boundary or bounded trusted-send contract; do not silently weaken existing Plan0248 language.
next_action: Root adjudicate application-send vs remote-execution semantics and authorize serialized minimal native seam red/green if removal of known async gaps is required; keep activation/695 closure blocked.
